project_type: Kotlin Spring Boot application with Vert.x web server
test_framework: Spring Boot test (no test files found - compilation is main verification)
verification_instructions: 1. Run ./gradlew compileKotlin to verify all Kotlin code compiles. 2. Check that no new compilation errors are introduced.
setup_instructions: Java 8 + Gradle wrapper included in the project
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Java target 1.8. JAR reference at /workspace/jarx/BOOT-INF/classes/ for decompiled signatures.
contribution_requirements: All changes on feat/migrate-pro-features branch. Matching JAR API signatures as closely as possible.
key_patterns: Controllers extend BaseController(coroutineContext). Routes registered in YueduApi.initRouter(). Utility functions are top-level in VertExt.kt. DB abstraction uses DB<T> base class with JSONTable and SQLTable implementations. Entity classes in com.htmake.reader.entity package.
directory_structure: src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/ - main app (api/, config/, db/, entity/, init/, lib/, utils/, verticle/). src/main/java/io/legado/app/ - book model layer (data/entities/, model/, adapters/, utils/). .github/workflows/ - CI configuration.
